extDescription.message: Review a pull request step by step next to your running app: comment on any element and see its console errors.

actionTitle.message: Review Walkthru: comment on the app

grantTitle.message: Allow Review Walkthru on this app

grantBody.message: Your app runs on $ORIGIN$. Allow Review Walkthru there to comment on the app, see its console and prefill its forms. Chrome remembers your choice.

grantDone.message: Done: the app reloads with Review Walkthru.

grantRefused.message: Chrome did not allow it. You can try again.

modeBar.message: Comment mode: click an element or draw an area. Escape to leave.

noCapture.message: No capture: press $KEY$ once in the app to attach one.
